rounds.text: Springform Technology Ltd is trading at a compelling valuation, with a price-to-earnings ratio of 8.92x against a sector benchmark of 18.23x, and a price-to-book ratio of 1.04x compared to the sector's 1.41x [E1, E2, E5, E6]. The business is demonstrating explosive fundamental momentum, highlighted by a compounded profit growth of 231% over the trailing twelve months and accelerating earnings with net profit up 140% year-on-year [E14, E37, E40]. Furthermore, return metrics comfortably outperform sector medians, with a reported return on equity of 22.0% and return on assets of 8.52% versus a sector benchmark of 3.05% [E7, E8, E12]. Insider conviction is clearly strengthening as promoters have increased their holding by 4.61 percentage points to 74.71% as of June 2026 [E26]. A discounted cash flow model places intrinsic value at Rs 23 per share against a market price of Rs 11.6, leaving a substantial margin of safety of 49.1%, while a reverse DCF indicates the current price implies a mere 0.6% earnings growth [E28, E29, E30]. Conceded: operating cash flow was negative at Rs -2 Cr alongside significant debt expansion to Rs 68 Cr in March 2026 [E19, E24].
